tldr: Mars through the 4th house heats up home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Mars moves through your 4th house, it adds heat and urgency to home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
